# The enums of Qt's `Qt` namespace as types of `Ljos.Ui` (docs/DIALECT.md
# §4.3.1): a line per enum, `<type> flags|enum <Qt's enum>`, then a line per
# key, `<Qt's key> <Ljós's key> <number>`.
#
# Do not edit: `crates/ljos_cli/tests/own_types.rs` writes this file from
# the engine's table (`crates/ljos_engine/src/ljos_enums.rs`).
